title: Trace determination of volatile polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons in natural waters
author: Benedé, Juan Luis
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Coat stir bar with MIL
steps.instruction: Magnetically coat a neodymium stir bar with the selected magnetic ionic liquid (MIL) to serve as the extraction device.

steps.title: Disperse MIL into water sample
steps.instruction: Add the MIL‑coated stir bar to the water sample, add the optimized amount of MIL, and stir at high speed for the optimized extraction time while maintaining the required ionic strength to achieve dispersion of the MIL throughout the solution.

substeps.instruction: Add the optimized MIL amount (as determined during method development).
Stir at high rate for the optimized extraction time.
Adjust ionic strength to the optimized level.

steps.title: Retrieve MIL onto stir bar
steps.instruction: Cease stirring; the magnetic field pulls the dispersed MIL back onto the neodymium stir bar, collecting the extracted PAHs.

steps.title: Thermal desorption of extracted PAHs
steps.instruction: Subject the MIL‑laden stir bar to thermal desorption under the optimized TD conditions to release the PAHs into the gas phase.

steps.title: Analyze by GC‑MS
steps.instruction: Inject the desorbed analytes into a gas chromatography‑mass spectrometry (GC‑MS) system for quantification of the ten target PAHs, achieving detection limits in the low ng L⁻¹ range, enrichment factors of 18–717, and relative recoveries of 84–115% (RSD < 13%).
